expected.evidence: CDS-C!C49:C51 explicit overall answers; all reported gender/status cells C27:C46 checked; residency rows C60:C77 checked
notes: Publisher inconsistency: 2024 overall applicants are 52,296 (CDS-C!C49), while in-state and out-of-state applicant answers sum to 52,498 (C60 + C65); international 4,921 is separately reported (C70). The source does not explain whether the out-of-state count includes international students. Headline counts preserve explicit overall answers; no residency total is inferred. The gender rows report zero unknown-gender applicants but 122 unknown-gender admits; those source answers are retained.

The 2024 file is a question/answer dictionary, not a visual CDS form. Blank answers are excluded from matching text outside C1, preventing printed score-band boundaries from becoming percentiles. Worksheet cells and original labels are retained.
